page.overview:
Who is Bonitasaura?

is a titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur hailing from uppermost layers of the Late Cretaceous Bajo de la Carpa Formation, Neuquen Group, located in Río Negro Province, Northwestern Patagonia, Argentina. The remains, consisting of a partial sub-adult skeleton jumbled in a small area of fluvial sandstone, including lower jaw with teeth, partial vertebrae series and limb bones, were described by Apesteguía in a short communication in mid-2004.

The genus name Bonitasaura refers to the fossil quarry’s name, "La Bonita", while the name of the type species: B. salgadoi, pays homage to Leonardo Salgado: a renowned Argentine paleontologist.

Bonitasaura is unlocked by completing an Earth Shattering [https://jurassicpark.fandom.com/wiki/Events/JW%3A_TG event]. Once unlocked, additional individuals can be purchased in the market for 150 DNA or found in card packs.
